proposals.title: Cross-pair information diffusion at the daily clock: leave-one-out basket lead-lag

checks.1_pit_coverage_warmup: PASS: 1-day warmup; decisions ~1,652/pair full window, ~1,630 from F1 start, ~11,400 panel (claimed ~1,600/~11,000 — MATCH). First decisions supported from the first full snapshot week; scored span aligns with F1 start.

checks.4_cap_gross_net_feasibility: PASS with a breadth warning: leave-one-out means share 5/6 components, so the 7 pairs' directions are near-degenerate (one common-factor sign). Caps/gross/net coherent; the inherited usd_corr_abs_ceiling 0.3 and long/short >=25% checks will likely bind — disclosed ex ante by the proposal itself.
checks.5_cost_headroom: THIN — PASS at base tier only at mid-band edges: ~1,900 RT x 3.0 bps ~ 5,700 bps aggregate base cost; break-even needs >=3.0 bps gross per 5-day trade (~0.6 bps/day, daily cross-autocorrelation ~0.03). Plausible band for daily-grain G10 lead-lag: ~2-7 bps per 5-day trade — base-tier RT (3.0) sits inside the band (clears at mid-band); tier-2.0 RT (6.0) sits at the top of the band (unlikely attainable). The proposal discloses cost-dominance honestly and mandates break-even bps; not INFEASIBLE because the expected turnover CAN clear base cost at plausible edges, but the margin is the thinnest of the six.
checks.6_control_identifiability: PASS, FULLY VERIFIABLE LOCALLY: own lag-1 self-signal control is price-only and excluded from the lead by construction; placebo benchmark (T-2 lead) likewise computable.
checks.7_drop_one: PASS: lead recomputed on the 6-pair set; ~9,900 decisions remain; non-vacuous.
8_implementation_risks: 5-NY-day horizon exit lands across the ~58 Friday 16:00-bar voids and holiday weeks — horizon roll must be defined on next-existing bars without fill-forward
near-degenerate lead directions across pairs: long/short balance and usd_corr gates must be computed exactly as inherited, not repaired
log-return weekend gap (Fri->Mon one return) consistency between lead and holding-window PnL

proposals.sample_floor_assessment: PASS by >250x on measured decisions; trade band matches claims

findings.text: Thinnest cost headroom of the six: base-tier break-even 3.0 bps per 5-day trade sits inside the plausible 2-7 bps daily lead-lag edge band (clears only at/above mid-band); tier-2.0 (6.0 bps) is at the band's top and unlikely attainable. Aggregate base cost ~5,700 bps over ~1,900 RT. Not INFEASIBLE_COST_HEADROOM: base-tier clearing at plausible edges is possible and the break-even diagnostic is mandated, but the family's most likely failure mode is cost-dominance (disclosed ex ante).

Direction degeneracy: leave-one-out 6-pair means share 5/6 components, so all 7 pairs trade the same sign on nearly every day — the book is effectively one common-factor bet x7. The inherited usd_corr_abs_ceiling 0.3 and the >=25% long/short balance check are likely to fire; disclosed ex ante (usd_drift_disclosure), but A1 selection should weigh that the mechanism's diversification is largely nominal.
